title: Tech Note: Importing Data to 4D View Pro
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D View Pro remains 4D's current native spreadsheet component (built on SpreadJS) and the object/range-based API shown (VP Get active cell, VP SET VALUE, VP Cell) is still the standard approach today. Later 4D versions have added more native row/column manipulation commands, reducing the need for the JavaScript workaround (WA Evaluate JavaScript / spread.getActiveSheet()) described here for resizing sheets.
related_updates: 4D View Pro has gained additional native commands for row/column manipulation in later versions, reducing reliance on the JavaScript-based workaround shown here
4D View Pro (built on SpreadJS) remains the current, actively developed spreadsheet feature, having fully replaced the legacy 4D View plugin
